summary.text: Checkout errors appeared after release v2.14.0, alongside a changed payments endpoint.

impact.text: 17 of 100 sampled checkout requests returned HTTP 503 between 10:02 and 10:03 UTC.

observations.text: The rollout completed, but its startup probes did not verify checkout transactions.
The payments endpoint changed from port 8080 to 8081; a connection to port 8081 was refused.
A cached health response returned HTTP 200 without exercising checkout.
The rollback request was queued; completion is not recorded in that event.

hypotheses.text: The changed payments endpoint may be contributing to checkout failures.
gaps: The approved endpoint and pod-to-service connectivity are unknown.

missingInformation.text: Recovery status and rollback completion are unknown.
missingInformation.whyItMatters: A queued request does not establish service restoration.
missingInformation.nextCheck: Obtain a rollback completion event and fresh uncached checkout checks.

missingInformation.text: The number of affected users and full incident duration are unknown.
missingInformation.whyItMatters: A one-minute request sample cannot establish unique-user impact or the incident end.
missingInformation.nextCheck: Collect a wider request window and distinct-user impact measurements.

missingInformation.text: The restart notice has no reliable event time.
missingInformation.whyItMatters: Its relationship to the rollout cannot be ordered.
missingInformation.nextCheck: Recover the original timestamp from the emitting pod.

nextChecks.text: Verify the payments endpoint and connectivity from a checkout pod.
nextChecks.rationale: The endpoint changed and a connection was refused; the runbook recommends checking configuration and connectivity.

nextChecks.text: Confirm rollback completion and collect a fresh checkout probe.
nextChecks.rationale: The rollout controller only records a queued rollback, while the health response was cached.
